profile.headline: I fix problems. Lead Software Engineer at Capital One
profile.summary: Thomas brings experience working in enterprise and high-growth startups with a skillset to support all phases of the software development life cycle.

positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led engineering effort to build a differentially private (DP) synthetic data platform at scale. 

Built managed solution supporting multi-modal (tabular, text) DP data synthesis.

Integrated solution with LLM to enhance dataset onboarding process, feature selection, metadata inference and hyper parameter tuning.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Delivered production pipelines for high-fidelity differentially private (DP) tabular data scaling to 100M+ rows. Data products included census-like project with geographic and demographic information. Deployed on AWS with Kubernetes and Pyspark.

Collaborated with design and product partners to explain DP concepts (unit-of-privacy, budgeting) to customers turning them into accessible features for non-technical users.

Designed centralized privacy budget tracking solution for enterprise.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led effort to evaluate performance of prototype system and proposed optimization strategies and corrective actions to scale software product. Created a plan to scale prototype service from single user deployment to Kubernetes cluster ready for 1m+ daily users. Built terraform scripts for app platform with AWS EKS with Fargate, EC2 and Karpenter migrating some functions to AWS Lambda where appropriate to save costs. Improved performance by enhancing application caching.

Worked with engineers to set career goals, mentored teammates, lead team through scrum ceremonies.

Worked with customer to identify use case for implementation and testing.
positions.insights: Cloud Applications, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +5 skills

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Enhanced and maintained software digital twin for terrestrial HTS platform (Python, C++).

Oversaw architecture development from single service to a suite of micro services ready for deployment in production environment.

Implemented OpenAPI spec to generate REST API between C++ microservices and external applications using cpp-pistache REST framework (C++, OpenAPI, QT).

Prepared detail design documents as per business and functional requirements.

Improved collaboration with customer and supported decision making.

Keep team epics on track and within deadline, both major deliverables were delivered on time.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contributed to software to perform optimization of satellite networks. This software covered on developing and analyzing new and existing payload plans, including support for beamforming, performing
capacity analyses (based on traffic profiles), and link budgets (C++, Python).

Implemented and normalized (BCNF) SQL models for Satellite Digital Twin in PostgreSQL.

Built Skaffold tooling, Helm charts, Kubernetes deployment and Docker infrastructure to rapidly build and deploy cloud-native microservices application.

Implemented OpenAPI spec to generate REST API between C++ microservices and external applications using cpp-pistache REST framework and openapi3 generator.

Built and maintained services to manage incoming gateway data, business engine, platform and other ephemeral data as well as deployment of that data to and from external vendor systems (Python, C++, gRPC)

Facilitated development efforts of a small company growing to larger scale enterprise software production.

Built pipelines and tooling using GitHub Actions for pull requests (Sonarqube), integration test automation (Gauge, Insomnia), Docker image deployment (Jfrog).

positions.title: Intern - New Technologies
positions.description:
Created solution to automatically build MSI installer for ATM software based on Visual Studio dependencies (C# ) shrinking package footprint.

Updated region specific code to work on data from different lines of products (C#).

Contributed to first-to-industry data ingestion and analysis platform for predictive service model (Python, Splunk, JavaScript, C#).

positions.title: Intern New Technologies
positions.description:
Built customer-facing dashboards using Splunk, JavaScript, Python.

Built software to model a new protocol to reduce service calls to ATMs. Analyzed frequency, severity and loss cost in algorithms.

Built Python tools to search dashboards and monitor system health.

honors.title: Eagle Scout
honors.description:
Eagle Scout is the highest rank attainable in the Scouts BSA program by the Boy Scouts of America. Requirements include earning at least 21 merit badges, 14 of which are mandatory for the award and  an extensive service project that the Scout plans, organizes, leads, and manages.

Awarded December, 2014.
